label: REGISTERED (preregistration/extractor_logisi.json, D34): REAL recordings (Kapucu 2022), our extractor with the depositors' stated settings and the logISI burst detector (S4), against the meaRtools output they published
status: registered; predictions judged as the registration states them

L1_burst_duration_closes.statement: the detector is what remains of the burst-duration difference
L1_burst_duration_closes.test: pass if S4_logisi pooled burst_duration_s has median ratio in [0.90, 1.10] and Spearman rho >= 0.90; fail otherwise

L2_spikes_per_burst_closes.statement: the detector is what remains of the spikes-per-burst difference
L2_spikes_per_burst_closes.test: pass if S4_logisi pooled spikes_per_burst has median ratio in [0.95, 1.05] and Spearman rho >= 0.95; fail otherwise

L3_hpsc_burst_rate_closes.statement: the detector is what remains of the hPSC burst-rate difference
L3_hpsc_burst_rate_closes.test: pass if S4_logisi burst_rate_per_min has median ratio in [0.95, 1.05] on both hPSC plates; fail otherwise

L4_rat_not_worse.statement: on the rat plate, where the fixed rule already agreed, logISI does not break the agreement
L4_rat_not_worse.test: pass if on Rat_MEA1 S4_logisi burst_rate_per_min has median ratio in [0.95, 1.05] and burst_duration_s in [0.90, 1.10]; fail otherwise

moved_s3_to_s4_post_hoc.label: POST HOC (named in the registration's assumption check, no threshold set)
moved_s3_to_s4_post_hoc.definition: |S4 / S3 - 1| > 0.10 for the same plate, well, DIV and feature
